data.title: A magical heritage stay above Valparaíso
data.text: Hotel Somerscales is tucked into a beautifully restored Victorian building on Cerro Alegre and every detail feels considered. We had sweeping views over the port from our room and the English decor is gorgeous. Camila at reception made our anniversary unforgettable with a little surprise on arrival.

data.title: Charming location, watch the stairs
data.text: The setting near the funiculars and the street-art murals is unbeatable and the room was spotless. Just be prepared for the steep cerro stairs with luggage if you arrive on foot.

data.title: Best seafood dinner in Valparaíso
data.text: The hotel restaurant blew us away with the freshest seafood and a fantastic list of Chilean wines. Tomás recommended a crisp Casablanca white that paired perfectly with the catch of the day. We came for one night and stayed three.

data.title: Lovely building but thin walls
data.text: The heritage architecture is stunning and breakfast with local produce was a highlight for the kids. Unfortunately our room picked up a lot of street noise at night and the heating struggled to keep up, so we didn't sleep well. Staff did offer to move us, which we appreciated.

data.title: Rooftop sunsets you won't forget
data.text: We spent every evening on the terrace watching the sun drop over the Pacific with a glass of wine in hand. The whole team was warm and genuinely helpful with restaurant tips around the cerro.

data.title: Disappointing hot water and slow wifi
data.text: I really wanted to love this place given the gorgeous Victorian interiors, but the shower ran lukewarm both mornings and the wifi was too slow for a single video call. Olivia at the desk was apologetic and knocked something off the bill, which softened the blow, but it shouldn't have happened on a business stay.

data.title: Spotless rooms and incredible service
data.text: Housekeeping was immaculate and our room was refreshed beautifully every day. Every member of staff greeted us by name by the second morning. This is hospitality done right.

data.title: Comfortable bed, compact room
data.text: The bed was one of the most comfortable I've slept in while travelling and the bathroom was modern with great water pressure. The room itself is on the smaller side, which is typical for a heritage building, but it was well laid out and never felt cramped.

data.title: Great value for such a special place
data.text: Honestly the rate felt like a bargain for the location, the views and the quality of the breakfast. We'd happily pay more and will be back next year.

data.title: Check-in chaos ruined our arrival
data.text: Our reservation couldn't be found at check-in and we waited over an hour while it was sorted, with no clear explanation. To make matters worse the room hadn't been cleaned properly and there was a lingering smell. The manager eventually moved us and offered a partial refund, but the first impression was badly damaged.

data.title: Victorian charm with ocean views
data.text: Waking up to the port view through the original sash windows was a daily treat. The antique furnishings and the painter's heritage give the place real soul. Camila could not have been more gracious.

data.title: Breakfast is the star
data.text: The breakfast spread of local produce, fresh bread and good coffee was genuinely excellent and set us up for a day of exploring the hills. Only minor gripe is that the lone lift is small, so getting bags up took a couple of trips.

data.title: Perfect base for the murals
data.text: Steps from the funiculars and right in the heart of the street-art district, you cannot beat this location for exploring Valparaíso on foot. Staff loaded me up with a map and their favourite cafe recommendations.

data.title: Beautiful but not very accessible
data.text: The hotel is lovely and the staff kind, but with my mother using a walker the steep approach and the stairs inside the old building were a real challenge. Reception tried hard to help carry things, yet the heritage layout simply isn't built for limited mobility.

data.title: Warm welcome and a cosy room
data.text: From the moment Tomás opened the door we felt looked after. The room was warm even in the autumn chill, the bed was plush and the whole place smelled of fresh flowers. A real home from home.

data.title: Solid wifi and quiet workspace
data.text: Pleasantly surprised that the wifi held up for back-to-back calls and the room had a proper desk by the window. Only reason it's not five stars is that the restaurant was fully booked both nights, so plan ahead.

data.title: Impeccably clean and full of character
data.text: Every corner of this old house gleamed and the staff clearly take huge pride in it. Add in the terrace views and the wine list and you have a stay we're still raving about.

data.title: Romantic and effortlessly elegant
data.text: The Victorian styling, the port views and the candlelit restaurant made for the most romantic few days. Olivia arranged a late checkout without us even asking. Faultless.

data.title: Great stay, minor heating quirk
data.text: Comfortable, characterful and brilliantly located near the funiculars. The only hiccup was that the room heater took a while to warm up on the first night, but once it did everything was perfect and the bathroom had endless hot water.

data.title: We'll be back without a doubt
data.text: Spacious enough for the three of us, spotless throughout and the friendliest team in Valparaíso. The kids loved the funicular rides and we loved the sunset from the rooftop terrace. Wonderful value too.
